---
title: "Stage 2 – R and Quarto"
case: eu-frames
bibliography: [../../references.bib, ../../references-new.bib]
---
The second stage is a first working session in R, and then R on the data of the case. The first steps are taught on a file small enough to look at whole, the 1,014 emails of the housing-audit case, in the module on R of the housing-audit site, whose blocks of code were run when the page was built, so that you can compare each result on the page with your own. The module on this site then takes the same tools to the country-year panel of the EU-frames case, 270 rows built from Eurobarometer surveys. The module on Quarto of the housing-audit site explains the document format in which your case report is written. The stage ends with the paper of the original author (OA) and the first sections of the case study, and takes nearly six hours.

## 1. R on a first file

[Open Getting started with R at Reading the data](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-reading){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work from [Reading the data](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-reading) to [A first figure](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-figure) in the module on the umbrella site, which works on the data of the housing-audit case. The sections cover reading the data and looking at them, the pipe and the datawizard verbs, and a share and a difference in shares. The sections then go on to a first table and a first figure, with tinyplot and with ggplot2. Type each block rather than pasting it, into the blocks of the module, which run in your browser, or into the workspace of that case from the [setup page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html#the-workspace).

## 2. R on the panel of the case

[Open R on the country-year panel](../../companion/intro-r.qmd#sec-formats){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work through [Other formats, and fetching data](../../companion/intro-r.qmd#sec-formats) and [The grammar of graphics](../../companion/intro-r.qmd#sec-grammar) in the module on this site. The first section sets out the files of the case and the routes by which they arrive, and sends you to [section 13](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r-further.html#sec-formats) of the second part of Getting started with R for the Stata and SPSS files in which survey archives distribute their data, the labels that such files carry, and the packages that fetch data from a repository or an API. The second builds figures of the panel layer by layer, from data, mapping and geometry to scales, facets, labels and themes. Type the blocks into your workspace, which holds the panel.

## 3. Quarto

[Open Quarto documents](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-what){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work from [Source and output](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-what) to [Citations](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-citations) in the module on the umbrella site. The sections cover the `.qmd` file and the render step, a small document knitted in the browser, Quarto in Positron, the YAML header, code chunks and their options, and inline code, and then captions and cross-references, Markdown, and citations drawn from a `.bib` file. Then render the report of your workspace, `index.qmd`, once, and read through the five tasks that you will fill in.

## 4. The paper

[Open the paper](https://doi.org/10.1093/esr/jcw008){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the whole article of the OA [@Teney2016DoesEUEconomic]. Follow the two hypotheses about economic crisis and the framing of the EU, the question on what the EU means to the respondent, the macro indicators and the multilevel models, and find the sentence from which SCORE took the claim.

## 5. The case study

[Read the case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read sections 1 to 3. They cover [the original study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-study), its data, the selections made by the OA and the focal estimate, and then [SCORE and Multi100](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-score), with what each kind of repetition found on this paper and the instruction that the analysts received. The sections end on [the five reanalysts](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-reanalysts), each in turn, with an assessment of their choices and the coding errors made by two of them.

**Shortcuts.** If you already write R with the tidyverse, read the section on [the datawizard verbs](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-verbs) in Getting started with R, which the course uses wherever they do the job, then the second step of this stage, and run the rest of the first step only where its output surprises you. If you already write Quarto, render the report of the workspace and move on.

**By the end of the stage** you have a script of your own that reads the panel of the case, `EUframes_cy.csv`, and draws the cosmopolitan framing of each country-year against its unemployment rate; a rendered Quarto document holding that figure, a cross-reference to it and a citation; and the claim of the case written in your own words.
